title: Size bound for strictification
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input vertices, and define its size to be $n$ plus its number of gates. The strictification of $C$ has size at most $4\,\mathrm{size}(C)+12$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs
